b.heading: TestSuite > id
b.quote:
The ID is based on the [project](/api/advanced/test-project) name, module ID and suite order.

The ID looks like this:

```
1223128da3_0_0_0
^^^^^^^^^^ the file hash
           ^ suite index
             ^ nested suite index
               ^ test index
```

::: tip
You can generate file hash with `generateFileHash` function from `vitest/node` which is available since Vitest 3:

```ts
import { generateFileHash } from 'vitest/node'

const hash = generateFileHash(
  '/file/path.js', // relative path
  undefined, // the project name or `undefined` is not set
)
```

:::

::: danger
Don't try to parse the ID.
